description.value: BC Liquor Store (BCLIQUOR) in Port Alice is a provincial government-operated retail outlet and one of 198 stores across British Columbia, offering wine, beer, spirits, coolers, ciders, and non-alcoholic beverages. It is the only government liquor store serving this remote northern Vancouver Island community, making it a notable resupply point for touring cyclists passing through the area. The store also accepts returns of empty beverage containers for deposit refunds, a useful service for cyclists carrying empties.

Neither the website nor OSM tags provide any evidence about bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any other cycling-specific amenities — all such fields default to null per the rules.
